items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I remember when we were in Chicago we used to go out at the Delisa Club. This is the old Mike DeLisa's club.

ctx.x: And then there was the Rythmn Club there. A lot of guys, all the musicians used to hang out around there. If a top act would come in town -- well, everybody's laying for them, you know. Yeah, these things happened all over New York, and they used to have them all over Chicago.

I remember when we were in Chicago we used to go out at the Delisa Club. This is the old Mike DeLisa's club. Was on the other side of the street. This is when Albert Ammons had a band. And the guy in there, Guy Kelly was on trumpet in the band, and Albert Ammons and this guy Kelly, and Israel Crosby was on bass. I forgot who was on the drums.
But they had a little band in there. And Leon Washington -- Goon was on tenor sax. And why, we all used to go in there and jam. Every night. And Roy was playing with Fletcher then, Roy Eldridge.
